entries.content: Practical problems on Union and Intersection of two sets.
General solution of trigonometric equations of the type sin x = sin y, cos x = cos y and tan x = tan y.

entries.content: Process of the proof by induction, motivating the application of the method by looking at natural numbers as the least inductive subset of real numbers. The principle of mathematical induction and simple applications.
Polar representation of complex numbers. Statement of Fundamental Theorem of Algebra, solution of quadratic equations (with real coefficients) in the complex number system.
Graphical solution of linear inequalities in two variables. Graphical method of finding a solution of system of linear inequalities in two variables.
General and middle term in binomial expansion.
Formulae for the following special sums: sum of n, sum of n squared, sum of n cubed.
Normal form. General equation of a line.
Random experiments; outcomes, sample space (set representation).
